name: Just to Meet You
overview: A thrice-widowed woman marries Ye Lang, the illegitimate son of a powerful tycoon, believing she’s found a sincere younger lover—only to be drawn into a hidden scheme. Reborn after dying on his wedding day in a past life, Ye Lang returns seeking revenge, but finds himself entangled in her charm once again. As love and suspicion collide, deeper secrets surface, revealing that someone else may be manipulating everything from behind the scenes.
